Stripe is running a High School Fellowship in Software Engineering — a selective 12-week, in-person summer internship in San Francisco or Seattle for current high school students and recent graduates, paid $60/hour. Fellows join an existing engineering team and own a scoped project end to end on Stripe's programmable financial infrastructure, working on things like payments, fraud detection, payouts, and merchant-facing tooling. The work is production code in Stripe's main stack of Ruby, Java, JavaScript, Go, and Scala.
